name: JellyRate
description: Users rate media items and view aggregate statistics.
overview: A Jellyfin plugin for user ratings: configurable 1-10 scale, per-user and aggregated views, library browsing by rating.

versions.changelog: Per-user ratings popover on library cards: hover a card (desktop) or tap its rating badge (mobile). Rating badge stays visible above Jellyfin's hover overlay. Uses the standard Authorization header.
